name: V1.1
body:
V1.1

🐛 Bug fixes

Quest category achievements now update from `/played`

Non-combat pet achievements now detect Turtle/Octo companions

Mount achievements now detect Turtle/Octo mounts

✨ New features

Movable / hideable minimap button (`Minimap.lua`)
- Left-click opens the achievements panel, right-click hides the button.
- Drag to rotate around the minimap ring; Shift+drag to free-place the button anywhere on screen.
- Tooltip shows current point total and control hints.

MiniMapButtonBag / MBB compatibility

MBB and MinimapButtonBag scanning

New slash commands
- `/rach minimap` — toggle the minimap button
- `/rach minimap show | hide | reset` — direct control / restore default position
- `/rach played` — sync quest count from `/played`
